text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown works hard toward her debut 
race. Among the rivals of her generation 
she will soon face is... the earnest and 
dazzling Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then there is Duramente, born of a 
prestigious athletic lineage. Everyone 
watches in anticipation, wondering what 
kind of race she'll run against them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there was no need to feel 
pressured. Trusting in the hard work built 
up to this moment, it was time for the 
debut race!
